devdoc.details: A contract that provides gas price and native token USD price data on other blockchains.

params.otherChainId: The ID of the other chain to get the cross-rate for.

params.gasAmount: The amount of gas used in a transaction.
params.otherChainId: The ID of the chain for which to get the gas cost.

params.gasAmount: The amount of gas used in a transaction.
params.otherChainId: The ID of the chain for which to get the gas cost.

returns._0: The gas cost of a transaction in USD with precision of `ORACLE_PRECISION`

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.chainId_: The ID of the given chain to get the price.

returns._0: the price of the given chain's native token in USD with precision of const ORACLE_PRECISION

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.chainId_: The ID of the given chain to set data for.
params.gasPrice: The price of a gas unit in the given chain's native token (with precision according to the const `ORACLE_PRECISION`).
params.price_: The price of the given chain's native token in USD.

params.chainId_: The ID of the given chain to set the gas price for.
params.gasPrice: The price of a gas unit in the given chain's native token (with precision according to the const `ORACLE_PRECISION`).

params.chainId_: The ID of the given chain to set the price for.
params.price_: The price of the given chain's native token in USD.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: GasOracle

crossRate(uint256).notice: Get the cross-rate between the two chains' native tokens.

getTransactionGasCostInNativeToken(uint2.notice: Calculates the gas cost of a transaction on another chain in the current chain's native token.

getTransactionGasCostInUSD(uint256,uint2.notice: Calculates the gas cost of a transaction on another chain in USD.

price(uint256).notice: Get the price of a given chain's native token in USD.

setChainData(uint256,uint128,uint128).notice: Sets the chain data for a given chain ID.

setGasPrice(uint256,uint128).notice: Sets only the gas price for a given chain ID.

setPrice(uint256,uint128).notice: Sets only the price for a given chain ID.
